goal: Score reviewer configurations against the eval corpus with an offline runner, record the baseline of the current single-reviewer pipeline, publish a record-based review-quality report, record per-round review timestamps so review duration is measurable, record reviewer model identity at submission so quality metrics break down by model, and add session-visible quality metrics to the imm-retro analyzer within its existing counting rules and boundary.

acceptance.assertion: Meet S1 in docs/specs/review-verifier-eval.spec.md: the runner scores a reviewer configuration per gold case (recall over confirmed_true by anchor or location; FPs on clean cases or confirmed_false matches; unknown anchors as new-anchor rate; unlabeled cases never in a denominator); a baseline run is committed under benchmark-results/review-eval with its numbers in the corpus README; the record report computes, from committed audit records only, rounds-to-pass median and p95, the resolved/refuted/accepted_risk mix, the security_boundary share of blocking findings, and advisory count per pass; the imm-retro analyzer additionally reports per author model the blocking split by violated.kind and refute/resolve/accept-residual-risk counts only where a committed fixture proves visibility; a fixture without violated.kind leaves the report unchanged; the merge gate is written down: recall not lower, clean-case FP rate not higher, rounds-to-pass p95 not higher, recall wins ties. It also carries the Jev supplement (spec item 6): a security_boundary mislabel rate from offline classification of violated.kind, experimental until scored on S0 gold, never changing a finding, record, or admission. It also carries the per-acceptance repeat-count series (spec item 7): per acceptance ID, rework findings across rounds and rounds since last finding, from committed records only; it decides nothing. It also carries the review timing instrumentation (spec item 8): per round the coordinator records reservation-creation and verdict-submission timestamps, and the report publishes dispatch-to-verdict median and p95 from rounds carrying both; pre-change records unmeasured, never zero; nothing gates on them. It also carries the per-model breakdown (spec item 9): the coordinator records the reviewer model the host reports at submission on the review history, and the report breaks recall, FP rate, and rounds-to-pass by model; model-less records are excluded from the per-model series.
